name: Ador Welding Limited
summary: Ador Welding Limited manufactures and supplies welding equipment, consumables, and automation solutions in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Welding, and Flares & Process Equipment. It provides welding electrodes, including C-Mn steel, low alloy and stainless steel, cellulosic, hardfacing, gouging and cutting, cast iron, and nickel and nickel alloys; and wires and fluxes comprising submerged, metal-cored, gas metal, gas tungsten, and flux cored Arc welding products; and bare and coated brazing rods, and brazing fluxes. The company also offers welding equipment, such as MMA, TIG, MIG, advanced multipurpose synergic, submerged Arc welding, and air plasma cutting …
